title: Is Vencimira Legit? Full 2026 Review
description: Vencimira review: an API copy-trading service with four strategy classes, a Hannover address, and no licence or minimum deposit stated.
author: Olivia Bennett
excerpt: Vencimira links your brokerage account to AI strategy signals through an API, but it names no licence and gives no subscription prices.
content:
Vencimira describes itself as a technology provider. It connects to an existing brokerage account by API and sends model-generated signals to that account, so orders execute without a manual step.

This review reports what the site says about its strategies, risk controls and fees, and what it leaves out, including a minimum deposit and subscription prices.

Is Vencimira Legit? What the Claims Show

The site says it connects users' brokerage accounts to a catalogue of AI-managed strategies, and that positions are mirrored through direct data synchronisation rather than social following. It says there are no hidden performance fees.

Automation and signals

Each strategy class has a stated drawdown control, such as a hard stop, volatility-scaled sizing, correlation caps or dynamic margin monitoring. Signals execute within the user's risk settings and appear in the dashboard history. The site says its signals are probability-weighted recommendations, not predictions of certainty.

Performance and ratings

The site says backtests do not guarantee future performance and that market conditions, broker execution and account settings all affect outcomes. Backtest figures appear only in the dashboard, so they cannot be checked from the public site.

Asset coverage

The strategies cover FX, equities, multi-asset trend and derivatives. The site does not say which brokers support which instruments, so a user should confirm the supported list with their own broker before connecting.

Costs Worth Knowing

Access is sold as a recurring subscription tied to account tier. The site shows no prices or fee schedule, although it says charges are itemised before renewal. Ask for the figures before you connect any account.

Who Is Behind the Brand

The site gives a company address in Hannover but no legal entity name, company registration number or managing director. It says it does not hold client funds, and it tells users to check their broker's status with BaFin or another EU authority.

Before You Register: A Short Checklist

  • Request the legal entity name and registration number, then check them against the public register.
  • Create the API key with trading-only scope, as the site describes, and confirm that withdrawal rights are not granted.
  • Confirm your broker's regulatory status with BaFin or the relevant EU authority before linking the account.
  • Find out how to cancel the subscription, since the site describes only API key revocation.

Risks to Keep in Mind

The site warns that backtests do not guarantee future performance, and it says aggressive strategies allow higher concentration and faster rebalancing. A connected account carries the full market risk of every trade, and the site does not state a maximum loss for any strategy.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum deposit for Vencimira?

The site does not state a minimum deposit or minimum account size. Ask before you connect a funded account.

Does Vencimira hold my money?

No. The site says it does not hold client funds, so the money stays with your broker.

How much does it cost?

The site describes a recurring subscription tied to tier but gives no prices. It says the dashboard remains free to browse.

Is Vencimira regulated?

The site names no licence or regulator and says users should check their own broker's status with BaFin or another EU authority.

Our Verdict on Vencimira

Vencimira is clear about how it connects to a brokerage account and about the risk controls it describes. But it gives no licence, no subscription prices and no minimum deposit, and its performance figures are not public. Our rating reflects those gaps.
